ds-1: jñāninām api cetāṃsi devī bhagavatī hi sā balād ākṛṣya mohāya mahāmāyā prayacchati
ds-2: durgame dustare kārye durgamā sindhusannibhe na bhayaṃ bhavataḥ kiñcit durgāśritamanaso nṛṇām
ds-3: sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalye śive sarvārthasādhike śaraṇye tryambake gauri nārāyaṇi namo'stu te
ds-4: śaraṇāgatadīnārtaparitrāṇaparāyaṇe sarvasyārtihare devi nārāyaṇi namo'stu te
ds-5: sarvasvarūpe sarveśe sarvaśaktisamanvite bhayebhyas trāhi no devi durge devi namo'stu te
ds-6: rogān aśeṣān apahaṃsi tuṣṭā ruṣṭā tu kāmān sakalān abhīṣṭān tvām āśritānāṃ na vipannarāṇāṃ tvām aśritā hy aśrayatāṃ prayānti
ds-7: sarvābādhāpraśamanaṃ trailokyasyākhileśvari evam eva tvayā kāryam asmadvairivināśanam
